description: 津波断層モデル(12)陸域における津波浸水深データ(4パターン)(再計算)(令和元年6月) [flood and tsunami] is a dataset listed in G-spatial Information Center (G空間情報センター), Japan, an open data portal, published or maintained by 内閣府　南海トラフの巨大地震モデル検討会. 内閣府の南海トラフの巨大地震モデル検討会において検討を行なった震度分布・浸水域等に係るデータです。 （１２）陸域における津波浸水深データ （１２）は（１１）の内ケース１、３～５について、津波浸水の計算に用いる堤防・防潮堤のデータ及び潮位の設定方法を精査し、再計算したものである。 問い合わせ... Coverage: Japan. The portal files it under the publisher 内閣府　南海トラフの巨大地震モデル検討会. Its tags are 中国地方, 中部地方, 九州地方, 南海トラフ, 四国地方. It offers 5 resource(s) in pdf, zip. The portal shows 2024-10-04 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is the data owner's own terms of use (see the dataset page). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-gsi-portal.
